myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Gravitas appears in greek tradition as weight, seriousness, dignity. The name's meaning, "Weight, importance", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Gravitas in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Gravitas remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity.
